title: Toward Holistic Evaluation of Recommender Systems Powered by Generative Models

bias_targets.methodology: Using automated toxicity and bias classifiers (such as Perspective API, HateXplain, and ToxiGen) to detect biased or stereotyping language in generated outputs, and conducting bias audits to measure fair coverage for underrepresented groups.
Evaluating open-ended textual justifications for cultural stereotypes or inappropriate contextual recommendations using intrinsic evaluation methods, automated rule-checkers, and LLM-as-a-Judge.
Measuring the overemphasis of internet-sourced popular items using diversity and novelty metrics (e.g., Expected Popularity Complement) at both the candidate retrieval and generation stages.
